SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD T
AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), T.UPTIME, 120) = #{year} AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), T.DOWNTIME, 120) = #{year}
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT R.EQUIPTCATEGORY, CAST(SUM(R.USAGETIME) AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS USAGETIME, CAST(SUM(E.PLANUSETIME) AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E
R.EQUIPTID = E.ID
AND R.EQUIPTCATEGORY = #{equiptCategory}
AND R.UPTIME > CONVERT(DATETIME, #{startTime}, 120)
AND R.DOWNTIME < CONVERT (DATETIME, #{endTime}, 120)
GROUP BY R.EQUIPTCATEGORY

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), R.UPTIME, 120) AS UPTIME, CAST(SUM(R.USAGETIME) AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS USAGETIME, CAST(SUM(E.PLANUSETIME) AS DECIMAL(12,4)) AS PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E WHERE R.EQUIPTID = E.ID GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), R.UPTIME, 120)
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), R.UPTIME, 120) AS UPTIME, SUM(R.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), R.UPTIME, 120)

SELECT R.EQUIPTNAME, R.EQUIPTCATEGORY, R.USAGETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), R.UPTIME, 120) AS "YEARMONTH", E.PLANUSETIME FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD R, T_CORE_EQUIPT E
R.EQUIPTID = E.ID
AND R.EQUIPTNAME LIKE '%' || #{equiptName} || '%'
AND R.EQUIPTCATEGORY LIKE '%' || #{equiptCategory} || '%'
AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), R.UPTIME, 120) = #{date}

SELECT T.EQUIPTNAME, T.EQUIPTCATEGORY, T.SAMPLEQTY, T.ORDERTASKQTY, T.AMOUNT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), T.UPTIME, 120) AS "YEARMONTH" FROM T_CORE_EQUIPT_USAGE_RECORD T
AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), T.UPTIME, 120) = #{date}
